North America.name: Astoria, Oregon
North America.message: Very cool bridge!

North America.name: Austin, Texas
North America.message: 2023 COTA F1 race! The city itself was okay, probably as good as it gets in Texas.

North America.name: Bellingham, Washington
North America.message: I thought this would be my future home for a while, until I realized how much I like larger cities. Still a great retreat location! Makeworth Coffee Roasters is the place to go. Edit: this was unexpectedly my home for the summer of 2025!

North America.name: Bozeman, Montana
North America.message: Apparently it was opening week at the college. Every hotel fully booked, so slept in the Rav4 with Aurora.

North America.name: Brewton, Alabama
North America.message: Work trip(s) - the owner of the Holley House B&B is the nicest woman in the world with incredible cooking.

North America.name: Brule, Wisconsin
North America.message: This is where I grew up. My family and the family of my siblings spouses have made up close to 10% of the population at some point or another. I somehow made it out of here!

North America.name: Cedar Springs, Georgia
North America.message: GP contract work - has very nice paper mill! Edit: had a very nice paper mill!

North America.name: Charlotte, North Carolina
North America.message: EPRI's headquarters - not a walk friendly place to explore, so no expenditures for you.

North America.name: Chicago, Illinois
North America.message: For how close this is to home, I should have gone here more often. Only once so far. I can see the appeal of living here, but deep-dish pizza sucks and I cannot assimilate.

North America.name: Coeur d'Alene, Idaho
North America.message: I fogot my poop bags in the car. I'm so so sorry please forgive me it won't happen again (great city btw)

North America.name: Columbia, South Carolina
North America.message: The home of my obsession for libraries. I've found several I like more since visiting in 2023, but the Richland Library will always be special to me!

North America.name: Copper Harbor, Michigan
North America.message: Copper Harbor is where it's at - lots of great trails to explore, best done when the leaves are changing colors!

North America.name: Dallas, Texas
North America.message: If you can't say anything nice about Texas, don't say anything at all.

North America.name: Dothan, Alabama
North America.message: Work trip(s) - Dothan is known as the Peanut Capital of the World.

North America.name: Duluth, Minnesota
North America.message: Got my degree here. Went back here after my trip around the world. Will probably be back here again. Go Bulldogs!

North America.name: East Glacier Park, Montana
North America.message: No dogs allowed, but Aurora is actually the goddess of the dawn sooooooo...

North America.name: Eau Claire, Wisconsin
North America.message: My first true love. Eau Claire is such a beautiful city - just a shame it's in Wisconsin.

North America.name: Fargo, North Dakota
North America.message: I've lived 45 minutes from Fargo for 4 years and have only been there thrice.

North America.name: Fergus Falls, Minnesota
North America.message: A place I called home during the entirety of COVID.

North America.name: Finland, Minnesota
North America.message: Not the real Finland!

North America.name: Glendive, Montana
North America.message: I was the only one in the hotel. The water was slimy.

North America.name: Grand Canyon National Park
North America.message: Need to go back some day and complete rim-rim-rim.

North America.name: Grand Coulee, Washington
North America.message: Stopped for the night. Who doesn't like infrastructure!?

North America.name: Great Smoky Mountains, Tennessee
North America.message: Somewhere which I need to spend more time.

North America.name: Houghton, Michigan
North America.message: Rode some MTB here.

North America.name: Indianapolis, Indiana
North America.message: Union 50 served me the best meal I've had in my life.

North America.name: Knoxville, Tennessee
North America.message: Work trip.

North America.name: Lake Forest Park, Washington
North America.message: This was actually my first home in Seattle, but it's easier to just say Seattle.

North America.name: Los Angeles, California
North America.message: Work trip - changed my flights and went to Seattle instead.

North America.name: Louisville, Kentucky
North America.message: FFA

North America.name: Lutsen, Minnesota
North America.message: Lutsen 99er and Superior 100M finish.

North America.name: Madison, Wisconsin
North America.message: I've definitely been here. I don't really remember it.

North America.name: Mapleton, North Dakota
North America.message: Stopped at the park for lunch on the drive to Seattle.

North America.name: Miami, Florida
North America.message: Did a 5k run by myself during a tropical storm.

North America.name: Minneapolis, Minnesota
North America.message: Ended up being sort of a temporary but much appreciated home.

North America.name: Nashville, Tennessee
North America.message: Hosted by a friend on the way across the country.

North America.name: Navarre, Florida
North America.message: How on earth did I end up living here?!? Just a short 3 month stay in a camper near the beach.

North America.name: New York, New York
North America.message: Maybe a bit too big for Big City Nick. Still a nice city to explore.

North America.name: Olympia, Washington
North America.message: Spent the night here, right across from the capitol building.

North America.name: Olympic National Park
North America.message: Cemented my love for the PNW.

North America.name: Palm Beach, Florida
North America.message: Spent $400 total for a 4-night vacation.

North America.name: Phoenix, Arizona
North America.message: College trip with the run club.

North America.name: Rugby, North Dakota
North America.message: They say Rugby is the geographical center of North America.

North America.name: Seattle, Washington
North America.message: It took 11 years, but Seattle is finally the place I call home!

North America.name: Sedona, Arizona
North America.message: Beautiful! Worth going back for some spiritual energy.

North America.name: Tampa, Florida
North America.message: Literal hell.

North America.name: Trenton, New Jersey
North America.message: This is what sadness feels like if it were a city.

North America.name: Vancouver, British Columbia
North America.message: I WENT THERE, TWICE! Not too bad, eh?

North America.name: Washington, D.C.
North America.message: Visited 3 times in 13 months - not at all before or since. Much more to do and see here.

North America.name: Waupaca, Wisconsin
North America.message: There is a super cool battery here.

North America.name: Whitefish, Montana
North America.message: Like a 5 star penthouse.

Europe.name: Aarhus, Denmark
Europe.message: Stopped for lunch on the train up to Hirtshals. Phone stopped working and I didn't figure out how to fix it for several hours.

Europe.name: Amsterdam, Netherlands
Europe.message: It's Amsterdam. What more needs to be said?! (P.S. - the red light district is in the center of the city, so if you always get a hotel in the center of the city, be aware of that.)

Europe.name: Antwerp, Belgium
Europe.message: Spent a few nights. Ate some chocolate. One of the most incredible train stations I've come across.

Europe.name: Arnarstapi, Iceland
Europe.message: Start of the Arnarstapi to Hellnar hike.

Europe.name: Basel, Switzerland
Europe.message: The hostel in Prague messed up my extension, so I left and took an overnight train to Zurich. In my spontenaity I then decied to get off at 7AM in Basel instead. One of my favs!

Europe.name: Belgrade, Serbia
Europe.message: The people are nice, but avoid pork at all costs. I'll be back when they fix their air quality.

Europe.name: Bergen, Norway
Europe.message: Caught a cold, missed a train. Lots more to do here (and in Norway)

Europe.name: Berlin, Germany
Europe.message: Loved the city. Met some great people. Anna taught me how intercity trains work, Kasia showed me how to use the S-Bahn, Stranger Chess learned me how to lose at chess.

Europe.name: Bolzano, Italy
Europe.message: Quintessential Italy. Would have been content leaving for another country after spending the afternoon here.

Europe.name: Borås, Sweden
Europe.message: There was a train derailment between here and Gothenburg so I was foreced to get off and take a bus. I decided to walk around and have dinner since I was already there.

Europe.name: Bratislava, Slovakia
Europe.message: Didn't feel like continuing to Vienna. Probably deserves more effort than I gave it.

Europe.name: Bruges, Belgium
Europe.message: Bruges is unique, but not my kind of unique. If you like history, this is the place for you.

Europe.name: Brussels, Belgium
Europe.message: People told me Brussels is boring, but I kind of liked exploring. Went back in 2026 and the St Michael & St Gudula Cathedral has some of the most impressive stained glass I've ever seen (and is free)!

Europe.name: Budapest, Hungary
Europe.message: Home of Erno Rubik, and cube stores selling at 5x MSRP. Actually beautiful though. A city I recommend to most.

Europe.name: Cologne, Germany
Europe.message: The cathedral wouldn't let me in with my pre-purchased ticket, so I walked around until I found a pride parade. I'll let you guess who was more welcoming.

Europe.name: Copenhagen, Denmark
Europe.message: Very Hygee. Still don't know what that means, but you'll find it here. Hostel group was top notch.

Europe.name: Dresden, Germany
Europe.message: Stopped on the way to Praugue - the creamery was very unique but crowded.

Europe.name: Flensburg, Germany
Europe.message: I'm not saying those filthy Germans stole from me, but I went in with an e-reader, and the next day I didn't have it. Either was taken out of my bag here, or more likely I just left it on a bench.

Europe.name: Florence, Italy
Europe.message: They replaced all the parks with paintings. I'm not sure I like that trade.

Europe.name: Gdańsk, Poland
Europe.message: Home of the world renowned M3 crane.

Europe.name: Ghent, Belgium
Europe.message: Ghent. Ghent...I went to Ghent? Oh yeah! Super cool library. And first time using a train-station locker like I'm some kind of hero (or villain??) in a Bourne movie.

Europe.name: Gothenburg, Sweden
Europe.message: It was just another nice city, as you'd expect in Sweden. Went to the Supergirl movie in theaters because it was hot out. Unfortunately, the subtitles being in Swedish was more of an issue than I expected, given all the alien dialogue.

Europe.name: Graz, Austria
Europe.message: As far as I made it that night. Did a lil' climb to the clocktower before my train.

Europe.name: Hamburg, Germany
Europe.message: Nice city, surprising large.

Europe.name: Haparanda, Sweden
Europe.message: The Swedish side of the border I crossed into accidentally.

Europe.name: Hellnar, Iceland
Europe.message: Halfway point on the Arnarstapi to Hellnar hike. What a joy!

Europe.name: Helsinki, Finland
Europe.message: A calm and friendly city which I frequent. Considered immigrating to Finland to move here, and spent a month living in Kamppi.

Europe.name: Hirtshals, Denmark
Europe.message: Grabbed some groceries and hopped on the ferry before the storm!

Europe.name: Innsbruck, Austria
Europe.message: Went to the top of Innsbruck, next time I'll hike all the way up!

Europe.name: Joensuu, Finland
Europe.message: Joensuu - another city for spending time with distant relatives.

Europe.name: Jyväskylä, Finland
Europe.message: Home of relatives

Europe.name: Kalajoki, Finland
Europe.message: Kalajoki is the home of my grandmother - a short trip to visit her gravestone and the land she grew up on. Edit: 2025 return, now inherited the land with my siblings. Future cabin??

Europe.name: Katowice, Poland
Europe.message: One of the coolest cities at night I've ever been to. Really want to go back.

Europe.name: Kaunas, Lithuania
Europe.message: Day trip only. Go to the Kiemo Galerija!

Europe.name: Koli, Finland
Europe.message: Hiking at the national forest!

Europe.name: Košice, Slovakia
Europe.message: Started getting burnt out of travel and needed to stop. Very committed ultra fans.

Europe.name: Kraków, Poland
Europe.message: Very party heavy. The gaming pub was one of the highlights of my trip though.

Europe.name: Kuopio, Finland
Europe.message: Really didn't see that much here, got dropped off at the train station to make my way to Oulu.

Europe.name: Kuusamo, Finland
Europe.message: The home of my great grandfather. Spent the night with the most welcoming relatives I've ever met, and wish to visit again soon! Edit: visted again on the expedition around the world!

Europe.name: Kyyjärvi, Finland
Europe.message: Home of relatives

Europe.name: Ladce, Slovakia
Europe.message: Well since I'm so close, I might as well go to the speedcube comp! No same day registration though, but fun to finally go to one.

Europe.name: Le Mans, France
Europe.message: Le Mans is much better than Paris and the highlight of my first solo-europe trip. 24 Hours of Le Mans happened to be the weekend I was in France, how fun is that!

Europe.name: Leiden, Netherlands
Europe.message: Did you know that homes in parts of Europe used to be taxed based on the number of windows, so rich people would have many, many small windows to flaunt their wealth? The canal tour was a great way to explore and learn about the city

Europe.name: Liège, Belgium
Europe.message: Just stopped here for a train connection, impressive infrastructure for what seems like such a small city!

Europe.name: Ljubljana, Slovenia
Europe.message: Cute charming city with great Burek.

Europe.name: Loimaa, Finland
Europe.message: Stopped for the night. Most expensive hotel on my entire Earth Expedition.

Europe.name: London, United Kingdom
Europe.message: It was hot. I was tired. I'll probably go back some day and do it properly. It's too bad they left the EU.

Europe.name: Lucca, Italy
Europe.message: A day too late to see the city, a day to early to enjoy the comic and anime convention.

Europe.name: Luleå, Sweden
Europe.message: Grabbed dinner and a quick walk through the city while waiting for the sleeper train.

Europe.name: Malmö, Sweden
Europe.message: Daytrip from Copenhagen with a beautiful Belgian woman. Well worth visiting if in Copenhagen and you have time!

Europe.name: Mechelen, Belgium
Europe.message: An incredible surprise! The cathedrals as disproportionately impressive in terms of quality and quantity.

Europe.name: Munich, Germany
Europe.message: Very nice, almost too nice to bother visiting again.

Europe.name: Naples, Italy
Europe.message: I didn't get robbed. Not sure what the big deal is. Could be nice to see more of the city, but really just a base for Pompei.

Europe.name: Odense, Denmark
Europe.message: Stopped on my train route south - went the Christian Hans Anderson home and museum. "To travel is to live."

Europe.name: Orvieto, Italy
Europe.message: The best part of my short stay was the adventure getting here. Could be nice for a night again, but not necessary.

Europe.name: Oslo, Norway
Europe.message: Still getting over a cold, and the Munch museum was closed when I was able to go. Need to go back.

Europe.name: Ostende, Belgium
Europe.message: Home of Delissa! And some giant orange trash on the concrete. Don't know if or when I'll go back here, but I want to do the Crystal Ship tour.

Europe.name: Oświęcim, Poland
Europe.message: Holocost memorial.

Europe.name: Oulanka, Finland
Europe.message: Hiking on the Karhunkierros trail to Juuma from here.

Europe.name: Oulu, Finland
Europe.message: Oulu, Finland, is much cooler than Oulu, Wisconsin. 10/10 reindeer burgers!

Europe.name: Paris, France
Europe.message: Yawn.

Europe.name: Pisa, Italy
Europe.message: I saw it and then I left (and you should too)

Europe.name: Plovdiv, Bulgaria
Europe.message: Overthrew the government while I was here. No big deal.

Europe.name: Podgorica, Montenegro
Europe.message: Rainy days and a cold kept me inside. Made some frineds with a couple stray dogs but that's about it.

Europe.name: Pompei, Italy
Europe.message: Explored the ruins. Can you find the room with 2000 year old sex paintings?

Europe.name: Porvoo, Finland
Europe.message: Cute little city with some red buildings on the water. Honestly can't recommend it as a day-trip from Helsinki, there's just not enough to do. More of a place to stop for lunch and a walk on the way through.

Europe.name: Poznań, Poland
Europe.message: Daytrip stop for lunch. Missed the goats by 8 minutes.

Europe.name: Prague, Czechia
Europe.message: Lovely city, but kind of a pain to get to and from. Went to a classical music concert with a lovely french woman name Lena!

Europe.name: Pristina, Kosovo
Europe.message: God bless Bill Clinton.

Europe.name: Púchov, Slovakia
Europe.message: It was 20 minutes faster to backtrack. The train was then delayed by 30 minutes so I went to have a coffee. By the time I got to the coffee shop the train was only 10 minutes delayed, and after running back I missed it and had to wait another hour.

Europe.name: Reykjavík, Iceland
Europe.message: The first stop on an incredible journey!

Europe.name: Riga, Latvia
Europe.message: Soviet influence strong. Buildings and infrastructure weak. Overheard a woman say the library looks much nicer on the inside than it does on the outside, but I think the weird architechture fits the cities vibe well.

Europe.name: Rome, Italy
Europe.message: It feels like there's so much to see! I mean, look at those tranmission lines!

Europe.name: Rotterdam, Netherlands
Europe.message: Rotterdam was my favorite city I visited in the Netherlands. Make it happen!

Europe.name: Rovaniemi, Finland
Europe.message: Home of Santa Claus and Martinii knives.

Europe.name: Salzburg, Austria
Europe.message: One of the cleanest cities I've ever been to.

Europe.name: Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina
Europe.message: A hidden gem. Would have stayed here longer but planned it as a halfway city on the way to Albania.

Europe.name: Shkodër, Albania
Europe.message: Had a pleasant time here. Got some patches sewed onto my bag for $2.00. Ate lots of Burek.

Europe.name: Siena, Italy
Europe.message: It's only a worthwhile daytrip if you start and end in Florence, not as a halfway point to somewhere else.

Europe.name: Sievi, Finland
Europe.message: Stopped for coffee and a donut.

Europe.name: Skógar, Iceland
Europe.message: The Icelandic horses and mountains were so beautiful I had to turn around.

Europe.name: Skopje, North Macedonia
Europe.message: Biggest surpise of my travels. I'm not sure why exactly but the vibe was great. Not exactly a lot to do, but a nice environment to be in. Long riverwalk, a unique indoor/outdoor shopping mall, and all the fake statues you could ever want to see. Spent 7 days in the same hostel, which was the longest out of anywhere I went in my entire Earth Expedition trip. Did a 1500 piece puzzle and the owner followed up months later showing he had framed it with a little note "Courtesy of Nick Korhonen". Super wholesome!

Europe.name: Sofia, Bulgaria
Europe.message: Was here the day before nationwide protests! The triangle of power was empty as I walked through.

Europe.name: Stockholm, Sweden
Europe.message: Loved the parks. Would be a great place to stay for a while if it wasn't so expensive.

Europe.name: Tallinn, Estonia
Europe.message: A short ferry ride from Helsinki, with a unique mix of historic and modern development.

Europe.name: Tampere, Finland
Europe.message: Last minute train to explore the city in the rain! Cozy library with great hot chocolate. And of course the Moomin museum!

Europe.name: The Hague, Netherlands
Europe.message: Den Haag! LOVED the sculpture museum near the North Sea - great area to spend the day.

Europe.name: Thingvellir National Park, Iceland
Europe.message: Hiking is so much fun. Would recommend.

Europe.name: Tiranë, Albania
Europe.message: Another great stop in Albania, perfect for budget travelers.

Europe.name: Tornio, Finland
Europe.message: I accidentally crossed the border into Sweden here without noticing. Be careful where you're stepping!

Europe.name: Trenčín, Slovakia
Europe.message: Avid football fans convinced me to stay on the train and go to the game with them. They got crushed, but really fun adventure!

Europe.name: Turku, Finland
Europe.message: Beautiful infrastructure - somewhere worth spending a couple of days.

Europe.name: Uppsala, Sweden
Europe.message: Did a daytrip from Stockholm. The barista validated my iced honey latte so hard. Will be going back there. Maybe will try to marry her idk.

Europe.name: Utrecht, Netherlands
Europe.message: A good city to day-trip to from Amsterdam.

Europe.name: Vaasa, Finland
Europe.message: Not a particular point of interest, but fun to walk around downtown.

Europe.name: Vaduz, Liechtenstein
Europe.message: My mom's flight got cancelled so I had an extra day before Munich, so why not add another country!

Europe.name: Vantaa, Finland
Europe.message: Dad didn't want to spend a day in Helsinki, so we slept near the airport and changed flights to a day earlier.

Europe.name: Venice, Italy
Europe.message: Wish I could have walked back and forth more. Still super crowded even when it's flooding (to be fair it was the weekend and there was a marathon going on)

Europe.name: Verona, Italy
Europe.message: Good base for visiting Venice and going to Florence afterwards.

Europe.name: Vienna, Austria
Europe.message: Planned four nights, stayed four hours instead. I'll go back when I have more energy.

Europe.name: Víkurfjara Black Sand Beach, Iceland
Europe.message: I went to the wrong parking lot and ended up taking a wonderful hike as a result.

Europe.name: Vilnius, Lithuania
Europe.message: Great hostel vibes. The bartender was doing his best to be my wingman even though I didn't drink and the woman I was talking to was in a relationship.

Europe.name: Virranniemi, Finland
Europe.message: Great-grandfather was from the village. The Nazis burned down his house when they left.

Europe.name: Vuonisjärvi, Finland
Europe.message: There is a really cool wooden church and community center here. Kind of a ways to get to though.

Europe.name: Warsaw, Poland
Europe.message: I'm sure there was more to see, but got bored and left a night early on a late train to Krakow.

Europe.name: Zagreb, Croatia
Europe.message: Much nicer than expected.

Europe.name: Zürich, Switzerland
Europe.message: This city balls. Hopefully you do to, or you'll be broke in no time.

Asia.name: Almaty, Kazakhstan
Asia.message: Something a little different, but still very familiar. Most American's would be surprised how modern all of the cities around the world are.

Asia.name: Ankara, Turkey
Asia.message: I'm gonna be honest, I spent half my time here playing Counter-Strike. I prefered Ankara to Istanbul, but also caught the worst illness I've ever had here.

Asia.name: Batumi, Georgia
Asia.message: 28th floor penthouse with a view and a nice TV to recover from whatever I caught in Ankara. I found enough energy near the end to go on a scavenger hunt for all the ingredients for chocolate chip cookies, only to realize I didn't have any measuring utinsels or a mixer or cookie scooper. They were terrible, but I still had fun.

Asia.name: Beijing, China
Asia.message: My dad told me I would get my head chopped off if I went to China, so I booked the first flight I could find. I discovered my addiction for hot bottled beverages here, and maintained that throughout Asia. Beijing was impressive, though very spread out. I was trying to walk across the city but as soon as I got close to Tiananm-

Asia.name: Busan, South Korea
Asia.message: It was really cold when I was here, but I'm sure it would be lovely in the summer!

Asia.name: Fukuoka, Japan
Asia.message: A very lovely city near the southern end of Japan.

Asia.name: Hanoi, Vietnam
Asia.message: I only had 3 days here, but tried at least 10 different coffees. It was all so delicious!

Asia.name: Hong Kong, China
Asia.message: A must visit. Puts NYC to shame. The skyline from the Kowloon train station right after arriving sold me instantly.

Asia.name: Istanbul, Turkey
Asia.message: Not my favorite city, but I know a lot of other people have spoken very highly of it. Maybe need to go back with a friend.

Asia.name: Kaohsiung, Taiwan
Asia.message: I just loved all of my time in Taiwan, and this was a great part of it. Discovered Iced Wintermelon Milk Tea here and got it every day for the rest of Taiwan.

Asia.name: Kobe, Japan
Asia.message: I think I wanted to enjoy Kobe more than I did - Osaka would have been a better 4 night stay. It was still nice to visit, but maybe only 1-2 days instead.

Asia.name: Ordu, Turkey
Asia.message: Very, very sick while visiting here. Booked a nice hotel for two nights and tried to recover.

Asia.name: Osaka, Japan
Asia.message: Cool city! The covered pedistrian street was unique and seemed to go on for kilometers.

Asia.name: Rize, Turkey
Asia.message: Just a stop for the night.

Asia.name: Seoul, South Korea
Asia.message: I don't think I gave this city as much effort as required. Need to go back and do more of the touristy things. At the very least, I took the cable car to the top of the big hill and hiked back down at night.

Asia.name: Taipei, Taiwan
Asia.message: So much culture. Had a local I met in Austria recommend the Raohe Street market, so I went and tried 5 different kinds of food, all excellent.

Asia.name: Tbilisi, Georgia
Asia.message: So much nature all over the city, hills and mountains, water, everything. The Georgian alphabet is also the most beautiful writing on earth.

Asia.name: Tokyo, Japan
Asia.message: All of my favorite places start with T. Tokyo has so much. Spent a full day shopping for knives. Several others trying to just scratch the surface of the city's area.

Asia.name: Ulaanbaatar, Mongolia
Asia.message: It was January and cold. Found myself a nice yak-down hat, and a coffee shop within not-freezing-to-death walking distance.
